sophie-finance: Heads up 10: SmartEdge flagged a billing dispute for March. They claim SDK tests inflated usage. Requesting one-off concession: $22k credit + 1 invoice 10% usage discount. Need deal desk approval.
mike-sales: Sales supports. Customer is on a growth plan and mentioned pause if not resolved. We verbally promised a small setup credit during POC.
oliver-salesops: Quick numbers: billed tokens 680k vs committed 400k. Overage line = $24,800. Attached reconciliation in sheet: https://sheets.internal/redwood/smartedge-march. Proposed shared credit = $22,000.
ar-bot: Invoice INV-2026-03-15, Amount: $41,500, Lines: Base: $20,700; Overage: $20,800.
sophie-finance: Notes: sales allowance (approx $8k) not applied; customer ran CI tests on prod keys. Tax impact minimal. Recommend credit + single-invoice 10% discount to avoid churn.
dina-cfo: I can approve up to $25k one-off credits with legal sign-off. Lara, please draft short addendum with non-precedent language.
lara-legal: Will draft amendment and include clause: "This one-time reconciliation credit shall not constitute a change to Redwood's pricing policy or create precedent." Send to customer for signature.
mike-sales: Customer will sign quickly. I'll coordinate DocuSign.
ar-bot: DocuSign envelope DSGN-112233 created. Status: sent.
oliver-salesops: CRM concession code DEALDESK-ONEOFF-2026-186912 added. JE suggested GL 4102.
sophie-finance: Dina approved $22,000 credit + 1 invoice 10% discount. Proceeding to AR once signed.
dar-unknown: (typo)
dina-cfo: Thanks team. Record the rationale in DEAL_DESK notebook and flag if similar >$15k trends appear. :white_check_mark:
